title: Choose the email marketing tool
question: Which email marketing tool should we use for launches?
expected: Open rate ≥ 40% on the first launch. 30-day review.

frame.problem: Two launch tasks are blocked because we have no tool to send the sign-up sequences. Which email tool do we commit to, knowing it has to be live before Oct 20?

vars.name: Deliverability
vars.ctx: Launch emails that land in spam cost sign-ups we cannot recover. We have no sending history yet, so the tool's own reputation carries us.

vars.name: Time to set up
vars.ctx: Michael has 5 h budgeted. Anything needing a developer or a domain warm-up longer than a week misses the launch.

vars.name: Cost at 5,000 contacts
vars.ctx: The KR targets 2,000 sign-ups; plan for 5,000 contacts within the quarter. Budget is tight until the first sales.

opts.name: All-in-one marketing suite
opts.desc: Email, landing pages and automations in one place. Powerful, heavier to learn.

opts.name: Lightweight newsletter tool
opts.desc: Simple sequences and forms, good deliverability, flat pricing.

opts.name: Transactional email API
opts.desc: Best deliverability and price, but forms and sequences must be built.
